cohort: The study included 1711 men and 7265 women aged 18 years or older, who were either pregnant or had a child younger than 2 years.
finding: Unintended pregnancy and various fertility treatments were associated with differing patterns of mental health risks, including psychological distress, chronic pain, and death fantasies, among men and women during pregnancy and early parenthood.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from participants who were either pregnant or had a child younger than 2 years.
